test_title: SSC CGL 2021 Tier-I (Held On : 19 April 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word.
solution:
The erroneous spelling is **"Exhast"**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The correct spelling of the given word is "Exhaust" which means "make (someone) feel very tired."
 
• Let's see an example-
 
 
• The long journey exhausted the children.
 
 

So the correct answer is **Option 2.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Adjourn- **to have a pause or rest during a formal meeting or trial
 
• **Ensure- **to make something certain to happen
 
• **Purity- **the state of not being mixed with anything else
